author: Marlon Chaviano
name: landing-nuxt
title: Landing page with Nuxt UI
description: Nuxt UI's official landing template: sections, pricing, testimonials and FAQ already designed, content in Markdown with Nuxt Content, and dark mode.

base.command: npx -y tiged nuxt-ui-templates/landing {{name}} && cd {{name}} && npm pkg delete packageManager

instructions:
## How to work here

- Each page's content lives in `content/` (YAML/Markdown) and Nuxt Content renders it; change the copy there, not in the components.
- Use Nuxt UI components (`UPageHero`, `UPageSection`, `UPricingPlans`…) before building your own; the theme is set in `app/app.config.ts`.
- Before finishing: `npm run build`.
